Hi Liam / Sophie -

Thanks for the list - please find our completed questionnaire attached and inline answers to the telemetry / SOC questions below. Happy to jump on a call to walk through any item.

Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_Completed.pdf

Inline answers (summary):

SOC 2 & Compliance:
- Current: SOC 2 Type I report completed 2025-11-20 (controls design).
- Type II: Fieldwork scheduled Q2 2026 with expected attestation delivery by 2026-06-30.
- Evidence: We can provide design-level artifacts now and targeted operational logs on request for audit purposes. A snapshot of our SOC program, control matrix, and the expected attestation timeline is in the Drive folder below.
  https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-soc2-evidence

Data residency & retention:
- Telemetry and operational logs are stored in region-specific AWS accounts; by default US regions for US customers. We can support EU region logging on Dedicated/Private plans; retention windows configurable per-customer for Dedicated and Private customers.

Telemetry / Cookies (Console + Docs):
- Console: Uses a first-party cookie 'rdw_analytics' for feature usage, page performance, and basic route-level usage. Cookie stores a short hashed session id only; we do not store raw user credentials.
- Docs site: Public docs use anonymized analytics (Segment) for aggregate usage and search behavior; we do not enable session replay on the docs site.
- PII: By default, telemetry does NOT collect PII (email addresses, names, full user IDs). Customers may enable enhanced logging (for debugging) which can include identifiers; such modes are opt-in and documented.
- Third parties: We do not send session recordings to third parties. Aggregate analytics are sent to Segment (anonymized) for docs; customers on Dedicated/Private can disable external analytics or route to customer-owned endpoints.

Next steps / timeline:
- Completed questionnaire attached.
- We will provide a package of design artifacts immediately and can supply operational logs for a defined audit window within 5 business days on request.
- We expect SOC 2 Type II attestation by 2026-06-30 and will share the final report once available.

If useful, I can set up a 30-minute compliance walkthrough with our Compliance Manager next week.

Cheers -
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
